_comment: The static RAM (.data and .bss) that the objects under src/ui/angulo define, a high-water mark in the manner of flash_budget.json. tools/check_ui_ram.py adds it up from the objdump -t listing of each object after every build (what counts is decided by section, .bss* and .data*, not by nm's letter, which calls a weak read-only table a variable) of an image that carries the Angulo and holds the total to "budget" exactly: growing past it is allowed, doing so without editing it in the same change is not, and a build that shrinks lowers it in the same change (a budget that only rises stops measuring). The heap pays for every byte: the telemetry batch drops to one entry below HEAP_RESERVE (TelemetryManager.cpp), 32,768 B with TLS telemetry. Padding between objects is not counted.
measured_on: 2026-10-16 perf/ui-angulo-2canais: 9,313 B (b9d9b37, same method: 9,205 B). 2026-10-21 s10b/c0b: pico2_w_angulo joins at 9,313 B in 33 objects, measured by the gate itself in the build of the RP2350 image (the Wire Angulo's number, the same objects). 2026-10-22 s10c/a2: 9,603 B in both Angulo images (+290 B): the palette's twelve resident tables of 36 B (six accents x two modes, built before Core 1 starts and only read) where four stood; the heap pays, byte for byte
